svg.text: Bought with Hearts (game points, never RF). Each frame's own head anchors the item; it never covers body ink.
The wardrobe on Friend #77949 and one Friend of every family
Each item in front (down), side (right) and back (up) view, idle frame 0. Colossus is side-only.
Mutant antennae, horns and crests poke through; a Side-walker and an F2 baby too.
The accessory follows each frame's own head through the bob and the walk, in all four facings.
